method: The full V002 synthetic suite re-pointed at V003, with validation failures now required to create no candidate. Plus 7 publication-failure injections and 1 pre-existing-candidate case, using test copies with one inserted TEST-ONLY patch before candidate_path(): race on output, link unsupported, partial write (ENOSPC), candidate verify mismatch, candidate create denied, candidate appearing before create, directory fsync failure. Plus a static check that V003 contains no unlink/remove/rename/replace/rmtree call. Each publication case checks exit 4, the exact code, success_claimed false, that no pre-existing file disappeared, the candidate state and the output state. No real input read except Claude-authored metadata in cases R.
